_: Campaigns whose stop scenes almost never name anybody, at under one in ten. Every one has a docx or first-generation origin and every one names somebody in all fifteen day stakes, so the cast exists and is absent from the questions. This is writing rather than a mechanical fix: a name pasted onto forty-eight scenes is worse than none, so it is recorded rather than done. Only shrinks — a campaign that rises above the floor fails, naming the line to delete.
